svg.text: U2 TSR 1-2450: pin 1 (Vin, marked) in c19
C1 470µF 35V: + in +24V rail, − in GND rail
GND bridge: left GND rail ↔ right GND rail
Rack fan controller - 2-fan TEST RIG on a full-size breadboard (WT32-ETH01 face up)
Top view. Rows 1-55, columns a-j. Every part/wire is placed exactly in the holes shown. Details and test procedure: README.md
PWM pin: the blue jumper may go here
tach-capable pin: the green jumper may go here
never connect a test jumper here
Default jumpers = main board FAN1 / FAN2:
fan A: PWM IN g31 → a13 (IO1, pin 26), TACH f26 → a12 (IO3, pin 25)
fan B: PWM IN g42 → a5 (IO12, pin 18), TACH f37 → a9 (IO39, pin 22)
Testing: move the blue end to every blue ring and the green
end to every green square; watch the matching entity in HA.
NEVER put a TACH (green) jumper on a2 (IO2) or a5 (IO12):
its 10k pull-up holds a strapping pin high (no boot /
no serial flashing). a13 (IO1) is PWM only.
Before powering: check both rails are continuous along the
board (some breadboards split them at mid-length), and that
+24 V only reaches the LEFT + rail, the fan pin 2 and U2 pin 1.
The WT32 is powered only through U2 (5V pin): do not also
feed it from a USB-serial adapter's 5 V.
